rubric.item: Runs the bundled Windows token script with the given address before adding the server
rubric.note: Trace call 1 runs intgral-start/scripts/set-token.ps1 -Url https://mcp.example.test/mcp before the mcp add. It ran without -ExecutionPolicy Bypass, but it is still the bundled script.

rubric.item: Adds the server itself with the single-quoted ${INTGRAL_MCP_TOKEN} header, no literal token or placeholder
rubric.note: Trace call 2 matches the expected command exactly, single quotes included.

rubric.item: Never asks for the token or has it pasted into chat; stops if the script rejects the token
rubric.note: The answer never asks for the token. The script accepted it (length 64), and the answer warns the user not to paste it into chat.

rubric.item: Says to restart before tools appear; the Intgral link comes only after that; no guessed ERP address; menu framed as post-connect and ends in one which-one question
rubric.note: It says to restart Claude Code and that the link will come from Intgral after the restart. No ERP URL is given. The menu is headed 重启后可以做 and ends with 选哪个？
Written in Chinese and brief: two steps, the next step, and a five-item menu.

agent_unsure: The token script ran without -ExecutionPolicy Bypass after the classifier blocked it; the plain install from step 2 was skipped in favour of step 3; the menu was shown before tools were available, so research and video items and the link were left out; the merchant preferences line was added because ws/merchants/casa-verde-es/preferences.md is missing.
